jobs.title: [机队] bm-c 仓面自报：分支/HEAD/origin/main/领先落后/脏文件（纯 git，不依赖仓内脚本）
jobs.cmd: git fetch origin --prune ; (echo BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) ; echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD) ; echo ORIGIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main) ; echo LEFT_RIGHT=$(git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/main) ; echo DIRTY: ; git status --porcelain -uno) > cph4/fleet/queue-receipts/node-sync-bm-c-2026-11-05.txt
